headline: Jamaica Assigns Four Priorities to New Mining Ministry
summary: Prime Minister Holness assigned four key goals to Jamaica's new mining ministry led by Floyd Green, including royalty reviews and alumina stake sales.
why: State policy changes regarding bauxite and alumina mining royalties directly impact domestic resource revenues and mining operations.

impacts.name: Jamaica
impacts.why: Adjustments to mining royalties and state asset stakes affect mineral extraction economics.
